description: This file defines the interface ProductAttributeDao, which extends a generic DAO for handling ProductAttribute entities. It declares methods for retrieving product attributes based on various criteria such as option ID, option value ID, associated product, or attribute IDs.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDao
classes.description: An interface for data access operations related to ProductAttribute entities, including methods to retrieve attributes by various criteria.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects associated with a specific option ID within a given merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects associated with a specific option value ID within a given merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects associated with a specific product within a merchant store and language context.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects matching a list of attribute IDs within a merchant store.
